content.short: db3 network is a community-driven Layer 2 decentralized database network.
content.description: When a dapp has a large volume of application-level dynamic data to store and query, relying on traditional databases can hinder user experience. A hybrid data architecture commonly described as web2.5 aims to blend decentralization with performance to keep interfaces responsive. db3 network seeks to provide a fully decentralized database solution to meet this need, enabling developers to use it as a decentralized Firebase with db3.js for building, storing, and querying data across their stack. This approach supports modern dapps that require fast reads and updates while preserving decentralization.
